steps.label: Day 1
steps.text: Start with the 1,000 Touch Ball Mastery program. It gets you touches quickly and shows you how a program works.

coach.intro: Your first three weeks as a coach. Do them in order — each one sets up the next.

steps.label: Day 1
steps.text: Set up the team and set your goals: team name, logo, and the weekly training goal you want players held to.

steps.label: Week 1
steps.text: Get your players on. Onboard the ones waiting to join, then check the roster so you know who is actually active.

steps.label: Week 1
steps.text: Assign the first homework from the Coach’s Board. Start small — one folder with a due date beats a long list nobody finishes.

steps.label: Week 2
steps.text: Check who trained, then run something competitive. The 24 to 48 Hour Challenge is the easiest one to start with.
